name: tfae_equational_criterion
statement: List.TFAE [ Flat R M, ∀ I : Ideal R, Function.Injective (rTensor M I.subtype), ∀ {l : ℕ} {f : Fin l → R} {x : Fin l → M}, ∑ i, f i ⊗ₜ x i = (0 : R ⊗[R] M) → VanishesTrivially R f x, ∀ {l : ℕ} {f : Fin l → R} {x : Fin l → M}, ∑ i, f i • x i = 0 → IsTrivialRelation f x, ∀ {l : ℕ} {f : Fin l →₀ R} {x : (Fin l →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M}, x f = 0 → ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : (Fin l →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Fin k →₀ R)) (y : (Fin k →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M), x = y ∘ₗ a ∧ a f = 0]

name: of_forall_exists_factorization
statement: ∀ {l : ℕ} {f : Fin l →₀ R} {x : (Fin l →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M}, x f = 0 → ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : (Fin l →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Fin k →₀ R)) (y : (Fin k →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M), x = y ∘ₗ a ∧ a f = 0) : Flat R M

name: exists_factorization_of_comp_eq_zero_of_free
statement: Type*} [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] [Module.Finite R K] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] {f : K →ₗ[R] N} {x : N →ₗ[R] M} (h : x ∘ₗ f = 0) : ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : N →ₗ[R] (Fin k →₀ R)) (y : (Fin k →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M), x = y ∘ₗ a ∧ a ∘ₗ f = 0
